metadata.title: Confidence-Aware Tree-of-Thoughts: A Federated Safety Net for VLM Agents in Smart-Home Consumer Electronics
metadata.abstract_summary: Defines a verify-before-act task and benchmark for smart-home agents, a dangerous-error safety metric, and a confidence-aware selective tree-of-thoughts router, with exact federated aggregation for fine-tuning.

sections.heading: Claims
sections.text:
What the paper proposes or defines, as extracted (section, page):
- **Dangerous-error safety metric** (category A) - Primary safety metric: dangerous-error rate P(ŷ=EXECUTE | y∈REFUSE*), reported with accuracy, false-refusal rate and execute accuracy across splits. (section III. THE SMARTHOME-VSV BENCHMARK, p. 5)
  > false executions are far more costly than false refusals (the user can easily retry)
- **Verify-before-act 5-tuple schema** (category B) - Task schema: given image, proposed action verb and target class, agent emits 5-tuple JSON verdict with label, grounding bbox, states and reason. (section III. THE SMARTHOME-VSV BENCHMARK, p. 4)
  > The label is one of EXECUTE, REFUSE_OBJ_MISSING, or REFUSE_STATE_CONFLICT.
- **Confidence-Aware Selective ToT routing** (category B) - Three-branch verifier: JSON verdict C, full-image yes/no A, bbox-crop yes/no B; soft threshold on A/B confidences vetoes unsafe executions. (section IV. CONFIDENCE-AWARE SELECTIVE TREE-OF-THOUGHTS, p. 5)
  > Replace the hard threshold of 0.5 in Smart v1 with τ = 0.7.
- **Single-token logprob confidence** (category A) - Confidence from single-token yes/no outputs: PA = exp lp(yes)/(exp lp(yes)+exp lp(no)); PB analogously, enabling calibrated soft-threshold routing. (section IV. CONFIDENCE-AWARE SELECTIVE TREE-OF-THOUGHTS, p. 5)
  > we read the top-20 log-probabilities at the single generation position
- **FFA-LoRA exact federated aggregation** (category D) - Federated LoRA training where clients share frozen factor A, train and upload only B; server averages B for exact FedAvg of ∆W. (section V. FFA-LORA FEDERATED FINE-TUNING, p. 6)
  > FFA-LoRA [13] resolves this by freezing A at its initial value and training only B.
- **Federated drift and recovery analysis** (category C) - Quantifies non-IID federated drift in verifier safety and the recovery from auxiliary branches, with bootstrap confidence intervals. (section VI. EXPERIMENTS, p. 11)
  > Federated drift is severe under non-IID smart-ho

sections.heading: Method
sections.text:
- **Dangerous-error safety metric**: Report accuracy and dangerous-error rate P(ˆy = EXECUTE | y ∈REFUSE∗) per cell; also FRR P(ˆy ∈REFUSE | y = EXECUTE) and the safety–utility frontier traced by threshold τ.
- **Verify-before-act 5-tuple schema**: Each example is (I, a, c): image, action verb, target class. Output 5-tuple JSON: label, evidence bbox, pre state, post state, reason; bbox required when label is EXECUTE.
- **Confidence-Aware Selective ToT routing**: Compute PA; if PA < τ return REFUSE. If bbox area Abbox > β=0.05, crop padded 10%, compute PB; if PB < τ return REFUSE; else return yC, with τ=0.7.
- **Single-token logprob confidence**: Read top-20 log-probabilities at the single generation position, aggregate probability mass of tokens whose decoded form starts with yes or no, then renormalize over the two aggregates.
- **FFA-LoRA exact federated aggregation**: Standard LoRA ∆W = BA; separate averaging is inexact: (1/N ΣBi)(1/N ΣAi) ≠ 1/N ΣBiAi. Freezing A gives B̄·A = (1/N ΣBi)A = 1/N Σ(BiA) = 1/N Σ∆Wi.
- **Federated drift and recovery analysis**: Compare branch-C dangerous error centralized versus federated on identical splits; apply Conf-Aware veto; quantify uncertainty with nonparametric bootstrap 95% confidence intervals over test samples (3,000 resamples per cell).

sections.heading: Evidence & Limits
sections.text:
- Evidence the authors report:
  - Dangerous-error safety metric: Used across five VLM backbones and three 500-example test splits; break-even cost ratios computed from raw counts.
  - Verify-before-act 5-tuple schema: 22,841 auto-derived samples from GQA/ADE20K scene graphs; manual audit of 40 labels found 90% visually correct.
  - Confidence-Aware Selective ToT routing: Federated aggregate dangerous error fell 76.1% to 47.9%; ablation shows C+A+B beats C+A and C+B on HARD-CONF for every model.
  - Single-token logprob confidence: GQA-test ECE 0.018–0.107, AUROC 0.927–0.979 across five backbones; yes/no variant appeared in top-20 for all 17,464 logged records.
  - FFA-LoRA exact federated aggregation: Five rounds over three non-IID households; A-matrix differences across clients were identically zero to machine precision every round.
  - Federated drift and recovery analysis: Federated branch-C dangerous error rose 19.3% to 76.1%; Conf-Aware recovered 28.2 points (37% relative); CONF-split intervals do not overlap.
- Limitations the authors state:
  - Dangerous-error safety metric: Dangerous error overwhelmingly measures object-missing failures, not state misjudgement; only 8 of 1,088 refusal examples test state reasoning.
  - Verify-before-act 5-tuple schema: Scene-graph-derived labels inherit granularity errors on confusable siblings; audit found four disagreements.
  - Confidence-Aware Selective ToT routing: Conf-Aware over-refuses valid actions on clean data, costing up to 18 accuracy points on smaller backbones.
  - Single-token logprob confidence: Requires yes/no to be single tokens; extraction flagged undefined if combined yes/no mass drops below 10−6.
  - FFA-LoRA exact federated aggregation: One backbone and a stylized fully-disjoint three-client partition; observed gap conflates non-IID partition with frozen-A parameterization.
  - Federated drift and recovery analysis: All numbers from single training runs with bootstrap intervals; multi-seed replication

claims.text: Evidence the authors report:
Dangerous-error safety metric: Used across five VLM backbones and three 500-example test splits; break-even cost ratios computed from raw counts.
Verify-before-act 5-tuple schema: 22,841 auto-derived samples from GQA/ADE20K scene graphs; manual audit of 40 labels found 90% visually correct.
Confidence-Aware Selective ToT routing: Federated aggregate dangerous error fell 76.1% to 47.9%; ablation shows C+A+B beats C+A and C+B on HARD-CONF for every model.
Single-token logprob confidence: GQA-test ECE 0.018–0.107, AUROC 0.927–0.979 across five backbones; yes/no variant appeared in top-20 for all 17,464 logged records.
FFA-LoRA exact federated aggregation: Five rounds over three non-IID households; A-matrix differences across clients were identically zero to machine precision every round.
Federated drift and recovery analysis: Federated branch-C dangerous error rose 19.3% to 76.1%; Conf-Aware recovered 28.2 points (37% relative); CONF-split intervals do not overlap.
Limitations the authors state:
Dangerous-error safety metric: Dangerous error overwhelmingly measures object-missing failures, not state misjudgement; only 8 of 1,088 refusal examples test state reasoning.
Verify-before-act 5-tuple schema: Scene-graph-derived labels inherit granularity errors on confusable siblings; audit found four disagreements.
Confidence-Aware Selective ToT routing: Conf-Aware over-refuses valid actions on clean data, costing up to 18 accuracy points on smaller backbones.
Single-token logprob confidence: Requires yes/no to be single tokens; extraction flagged undefined if combined yes/no mass drops below 10−6.
FFA-LoRA exact federated aggregation: One backbone and a stylized fully-disjoint three-client partition; observed gap conflates non-IID partition with frozen-A parameterization.
Federated drift and recovery analysis: All numbers from single training runs with bootstrap intervals; multi-seed replication and federated controls remain future work.
Limitations they do not state: not assessed. Results are the authors' own, from their simulations, benchmarks or surveys; none evaluates delegation to cheaper models on software work.
